title: PublicAppSettings
description: Public browser bootstrap settings. SMTP configuration, secret values, and other administrator-only settings must not be included.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name used by the Control Panel UI.

turnstile_configured.description: Configured status only. The Turnstile secret is never returned.

google_analytics_measurement_id.description: Public GA4 measurement ID. Present only when analytics is enabled and the saved ID is valid.
